lore: A solar plasma flare killed 97% of humanity. Survivors reclaim abandoned infrastructure, form tribes, and fight over territory and income-producing bases.

asset_contract.layout: 2x2 sheet: top-left tree, top-right weapon, bottom-left hero, bottom-right enemy
asset_contract.framing: isolated game-ready cutouts, clear silhouette, no text, no watermark
asset_contract.gameplay: hero and enemy readable at small scale; weapon designed for socket-based asset swapping
